compute_auc_from_roc_curve: compute area under the curve using the trapezoidal rule from x and y coordinates
create_average_precision_score: create average precision score from prediction scores to summarize a precision-recall curve
test_roc_auc_score: test the roc_auc_score function to compute area under the receiver operating characteristic curve for binary and multiclass classification
generate_precision_recall_curve: generate precision-recall pairs for different probability thresholds in binary classification
build_det_curve: build detection error tradeoff curve for evaluation of ranking and error tradeoffs in binary classification
